# Artwork that is not ours

Kept here for provenance. The game does not load these files — the bytes are
embedded in `cursor-race.html` as data URIs, because the same file has to run
both as a claude.ai artifact and on our own domain, and only an embedded copy
works in both.

Credit lives in `ART_CREDITS` in `cursor-race.html`, which the terms screen
reads directly, so what players are shown cannot drift from what ships.

All three are the 96×96 animated previews, fetched 23–24 October 2026.

## kamishs-wrath-busy.webp

- **Creator:** Cursors-4U.com
- **Licence:** [CC BY-NC 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/)
- **Source:** https://www.cursors-4u.com/cursor/kamishs-wrath-solo-leveling-busy

Depicts Kamish from Solo Leveling. Cursors-4U licensed their rendering, not the
character; those rights rest with its creators and a CC licence from a third
party cannot grant them.

## azure-aura.webp

- **Creator:** Cursors-4U.com
- **Licence:** [CC BY-NC 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/)
- **Source:** https://www.cursors-4u.com/cursor/azure-aura-working

Abstract, so no third-party character sits behind it.

## mc-sword.webp

- **Creator:** nhatnamlt, via Cursors-4U.com
- **Licence:** [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)
- **Source:** https://www.cursors-4u.com/cursor/sword-minecraft

CC0 asks for nothing, not even credit; we credit anyway. It draws on Minecraft,
whose rights rest with Mojang, and the uploader's dedication cannot speak for
them.

## The NonCommercial condition

Two of the three are NonCommercial. The moment this game carries advertising,
sells coins, or takes money in any other way, both have to come out. The terms
screen saying the game takes no money is not only a promise to players — it is
the condition that artwork is used under.

## Asked for, and not added

These were requested and left out. Each is marked **Personal Use Only** on
Cursors-4U, and the site's own terms read: *"You may use them on your personal
devices. You may share cursors with friends for personal use."* A public website
serving the file to anyone who visits, from a public repository, is past that —
and where a named creator chose that label, it is their call rather than the
site's.

| cursor | creator |
| --- | --- |
| [Electricity Lightning HD](https://www.cursors-4u.com/cursor/electricity-lightning-hd) | — |
| [Slapping Cat](https://www.cursors-4u.com/cursor/slapping-cat) | StrayRogue |
| [Blue Velvet Arrow](https://www.cursors-4u.com/cursor/blue-velvet-arrow) | Phantom |
| [Golden Steampunk Handwriting](https://www.cursors-4u.com/cursor/golden-steampunk-handwriting) | Phantom |
| [Ryomen Sukuna Finger](https://www.cursors-4u.com/cursor/ryomen-sukuna-finger-jujutsu-kaisen) | Cursors-4U.com |

Drawing these themes in the game's own style would carry no licence at all,
tint to the pilot's colour like every other cursor, and weigh nothing.
